# Anki Forge

> Anki Forge generates Anki APKG decks from code using Rust, Node / TypeScript or Python.

Current public package version: 0.3.1. Normal export does not require Anki. Published package APIs differ from source builds. Keep the original previous distribution APKG for updates; Anki import settings and newer local edits can affect the result.

- Rust: `cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1` (Rust 1.92+)
- Node / TypeScript: `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` (Node.js 22.13+)
- Python: `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+)

## Start here

- [Build Anki decks from code](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/index.md): Choose a language, build your first deck, and learn how to add media, templates and repeatable updates.
- [Choose your language](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/languages/index.md): Install the public Rust, Node or Python package and export your first Anki deck.
- [Compatibility and releases](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/index.md): Published packages, verified environments and Anki client conditions.

## Quickstarts

- [Generate Anki flashcards with Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/quickstart/index.md): Install the public Rust package, write a Spanish flashcard, and export a persistent APKG file.
- [Generate Anki flashcards with Node.js](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/index.md): Install ankiforge from npm, generate Anki flashcards with Node.js or TypeScript, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.
- [Generate Anki flashcards with Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/index.md): Install ankiforge from PyPI, generate Anki flashcards with a short Python script, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.

## API references

- [Public API overview](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/api/index.md): Find Rust, Python and Node APIs for authoring, media, diagnostics and updates.
- [Rust API guide](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/rust-api/index.md): Find public authoring methods, build defaults, reports and diagnostic behavior.
- [Node and TypeScript API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/index.md): Public methods, async behavior, build options and reports.
- [Python API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-api/index.md): Project, media, build options, reports and temporary artifact ownership.

## Task guides

- [CSV to Anki: generate flashcards with Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/csv-to-anki/index.md): Convert a UTF-8 vocabulary spreadsheet to an Anki APKG with a complete Python script, sample CSV, stable note IDs and import checks.
- [Generate and update Anki decks from JSON](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/json-to-anki/index.md): Read JSON with Rust, Python or TypeScript, package images and audio, then review an answer-only APKG update.
- [AI-assisted Anki flashcards: from notes to APKG](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/ai-anki-cards/index.md): Draft Anki cards with an AI assistant, review the answers, then export an APKG using Anki Forge. Follow a CSV workflow or use a coding-assistant brief.
- [Generate Anki Basic and Cloze flashcards](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/cards/index.md): Generate Anki Basic question-and-answer and Cloze fill-in-the-blank cards from code. A verified Rust example builds two notes and three cards.
- [Add images and audio to Anki cards](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/media/index.md): Add images and audio to generated Anki cards with Rust, Python or Node.js. Import files, compose card content, and manage export names, MIME types and budgets.
- [Reusable Anki card templates, CSS and media](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/templates/index.md): Load a reusable Anki note type from one bundle of card templates, CSS and media, for normal or Cloze cards, with Rust, Python or Node.js.
- [Generate Anki Image Occlusion cards](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/image-occlusion/index.md): Create Anki Image Occlusion cards programmatically from an image and the rectangle masks you supply, in either occlusion mode, with Rust, Python or Node.js.
- [Update Anki decks with stable note IDs](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/index.md): Release a new version of a generated Anki deck: keep stable note IDs, build from the previous original APKG and review the comparison before publishing.

## Constraints

- [Build and output guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/index.md): Understand temporary artifacts, path protection and candidate publication.
- [Troubleshooting](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/troubleshooting/index.md): Resolve installation, media, template, identity and output errors.

## Optional

- [Anki Forge vs genanki: choose for your workflow](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/anki-forge-vs-genanki/index.md): Compare Anki APKG authoring workflows, runtime requirements, update review and migration costs.
- [Move from genanki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/genanki-migration/index.md): Understand content, template and media behavior when moving to Anki Forge.
- [Build SDKs from source](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/development/index.md): Development/source environment. Build SDKs and examples from a source checkout.
- [Build your first Anki deck with Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/blog/your-first-anki-deck/index.md): Historical article, published 2026-09-22. From a short Rust program to a Spanish flashcard you can open in Anki.

# Generate Anki flashcards with Python

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/
Language: en
Description: Install ankiforge from PyPI, generate Anki flashcards with a short Python script, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.

Create and activate a virtual environment, then install the [public PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/):

```sh
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1
```

On Windows, activate with `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. Use ordinary CPython 3.11 or later and a matching platform wheel; CPython 3.11–3.14 is covered by recorded release checks; see [verified environments](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/).

## Export a deck

Save this as `main.py`:

```python
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions

project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')
project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))
output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))
print(output.artifact.path)
```

```sh
python main.py
```

Open the persistent `spanish.apkg` in Anki. It contains **hola → hello** in **Spanish**. Keep namespace `spanish` and note key `es:hola` stable for later edits. Exporting does not require Anki to be installed.

## Continue

For a vocabulary spreadsheet, follow [CSV to Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/csv-to-anki/). To draft cards from source notes, start with [AI-assisted card generation](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/ai-anki-cards/).

-   [Images and audio](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/media/) and [Python media API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-api/#media-and-occlusion)
-   [Custom note types](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/custom-notetypes/) and [template bundles](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/templates/)

-   [Compare and update](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/)

# Python API

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-api/
Language: en
Description: Project, media, build options, reports and temporary artifact ownership.

The SDK calls the default Rust public API through a native extension. It includes `py.typed` and checked public signatures. Start with the [quickstart](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/).

## Project and note values

| Entry | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `Project(namespace, *, default_deck=None)` | Validates the explicit stable namespace and configures the default deck |
| `project.add(key, note)` | Atomically collects the note, model and owned media; duplicate note keys fail |
| `project.add_asset(media)` | Includes an explicit raw HTML/CSS/script dependency |
| `len(project)` | Number of successfully added notes |
| `Note.basic(front, back)` | Built-in Basic model; strings mean Text |
| `Note.cloze(text)` | Built-in Cloze model; strings mean Text and retain cloze syntax |
| `note.field(key, content)` | Returns a new note with the field assignment; key validation occurs on add |
| `note.deck(name)` / `.tag(tag)` / `.tags(tags)` | Returns a configured note |
| `note.note_type` | The immutable owned model |

Ordinary strings become Text. `Content.text(value)` and `Content.html(value)` are explicit constructors; `Content.sequence(iterable)` composes strings and content without rendering or losing media dependencies. A field does not accept a raw filename as a media reference.

## Models and templates

`NoteType.builder(key)` returns an immutable builder. Its `.name`, `.field`, `.template`, `.css`, `.cloze_field` and `.asset` methods return updated builders. `.build()` validates the complete definition and returns an immutable NoteType. `model.note()` creates a note owning that model. `NoteType.from_bundle(path, limits=MediaLimits())` loads the same model and its assets from the current bundle format; the optional budget applies separately to each asset before reading.

`Field(key, name=None, required=False, sort=False)` separates the stable key from the display name. `Template(key, front, back, name=None, browser_front=None, browser_back=None, target_deck=None, generation=GenerationRule())` uses field keys in every source string. `GenerationRule.all(keys)` and `.any(keys)` configure card generation. The default infers Anki’s field-presence condition. A builder’s `.cloze_field(key)` declares custom cloze generation.

## Media and occlusion

| Entry | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `Media.file(path, *, limits=MediaLimits())` | Reads an owned snapshot immediately |
| `Media.bytes(data, media_type, *, limits=MediaLimits())` | Owns bytes with an explicit MIME type |
| `media.with_export_name(name)` | Returns a new filename value sharing the snapshot; previous references retain their names |
| `media.filename`, `media.media_type`, `len(media)` | Read-only snapshot metadata |
| `media.image()` / `.sound()` | Typed content that retains the snapshot |

`MediaLimits(max_bytes=256 << 20)` controls each import before snapshot creation. Large media can spill to owned temporary storage. Naming conflicts are validated across all explicit and automatically collected assets.

`Note.image_occlusion(media)` returns an ImageOcclusionBuilder. Chain `.mask(Mask.rect(key, x, y, width, height))`, optionally `.mode(OcclusionMode.HIDE_ONE_GUESS_ONE)`, then `.build()`. The default mode is `HIDE_ALL_GUESS_ONE`. Completion decodes the image and validates stable mask keys and finite in-bounds pixel coordinates. On the returned Note, set `header`, `back_extra` or `comments` normally. The generated `image` and `occlusion` fields cannot be assigned manually.

## Operations and results

| Entry | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` | BuildOutput with a guaranteed persistent artifact |
| `project.build(BuildOptions.temporary())` | BuildOutput with an owned temporary artifact |
| `options.update_from(path)` | Returns options for updating from complete baseline evidence |
| `project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` | Completed ComparisonReport, including a separate publication policy decision |
| `options.update_policy(policy)` | Applies explicit risk policy to Update/Compare; invalid for Create |
| `options.inspect_limits(limits)` | Applies finite limits independently to baseline and candidate |

BuildOutput has `.artifact`, `.report` and `.snapshot()`. BuildReport exposes `.counts` (BuildCounts with notes/cards/media), `.diagnostics`, `.comparison` and `.snapshot()`. A report has no outcome or file owner. ComparisonReport exposes `.findings`, `.policy`, `.allows_publication` and `.snapshot()`. Snapshots are ordinary JSON-serializable dictionaries and contain no artifact ownership.

ApkgArtifact exposes `.path`, `.persist_to(path)` and `.close()`. Copying it with `copy.copy` retains another owner; a context manager releases that owner on exit. Temporary output disappears when its last owner is released. Persistent paths survive handle cleanup. A failed persist keeps the source handle usable.

`UpdatePolicy()` blocks High and Critical findings. `.fail_on(RiskLevel.MEDIUM)` changes the threshold. `.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` explicitly accepts the whole registered category, preserving evidence. Unknown codes fail immediately. `InspectLimits` exposes all finite byte/count budgets, including `max_identity_bytes`; it cannot disable required inspections.

## Errors and concurrency

Failures raise SchemaError, AddError, MediaError, ImageOcclusionError, TemplateBundleError, CompareError, PolicyError, BuildError or PersistError. Each exposes `kind`, `code`, `details`, structured observations in `source_details`, and source-chain text in `causes`, and retains the native exception as `__cause__`. I/O causes retain a chained OSError where available. BuildError provides `.report` and `.snapshot()`; CompareError provides partial `.report`; PersistError details include actual publication facts.

Native Project operations release the GIL and reject simultaneous use of the same object with `BINDING.PROJECT_BUSY`; independent projects can run concurrently. After a process fork, recreate all native values and handles. Inherited handles reject operations with `BINDING.FORKED_OBJECT`, and their cleanup cannot remove parent-owned files. Child-created values operate and clean up normally. See [diagnostics](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-diagnostics/).

## Addition context

Failed additions leave the project unchanged. Structured context records the original note/model keys and the target, with optional conflict or media usage details. Rust exposes `note::{AddContext, AddTarget, AddDetail}` through `AddError::context()` / `detail()`; SDKs expose `AddError.details` with typed context/detail. Node fields use camelCase and are deeply frozen; Python uses snake\_case TypedDicts. Tags retain their insertion index; field locations retain original sequence indices (null/None for the field, \[\] for its root) and optional UTF-8 byte ranges. Default-deck errors from build have no note/model keys and remain available in the source chain.

Typed images require image/\* MIME at addition; sound references accept audio/\* or video/\*. Other categories raise `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`. Constructors stay infallible; explicit assets and raw HTML are unaffected. The check uses retained import MIME, and does not certify playback. Build’s independent MIME/extension validation still applies. See [the design](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/plans/2026-09-28-rust-api-validation-and-errors-design.md) for the complete target/detail table.

## Source API details

Batch media and prepared publication are included in the public `0.3.1` package.

### Prepare, review and publish

```python
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError
project = Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'))
previous = project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'))
previous.artifact.close()
prepared = project.prepare_publication(
    BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').update_from('previous.apkg')
)
try:
    report = prepared.report  # observations; does not own the candidate
    if report.comparison is None or report.comparison.allows_publication:
        output = prepared.publish()
        output.artifact.close()  # persistent next.apkg remains
except BuildError as error:
    print(error.snapshot()['result'])  # actual publication/durability facts
    raise
finally:
    prepared.close()  # idempotent; deletes an unused candidate
```

One publish attempt consumes the owner, including policy or I/O failure. Later calls raise `PreparedPublicationStateError` with code `BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE` and reason `closed` or `consumed`; close does not cancel an already running publication. Relative paths bind at preparation invocation, and Project changes cannot modify the reviewed APKG. Reports survive close without retaining files. Change options or retry by preparing again. Duration excludes review waiting. Late errors can mean replacement succeeded with unconfirmed durability; inspect publication facts before deciding what to do. Native binding protocol 1 and contract bundle 2.1.0 are required; older same-version binaries are rejected.

# Compatibility and releases

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/
Language: en
Description: Published packages, verified environments and Anki client conditions.

## Packages and verified environments

Public Rust, npm and PyPI packages are `0.3.1` as checked on 2026-10-13. Start with [Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/installation/), [Node / TypeScript](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/) or [Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/).

| Interface | Package | Runtime and verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://crates.io/crates/ankiforge) | Rust 1.92.0 and current stable; packaged consumers on all four supported platforms, plus a fresh public crates.io consumer |
| Node / TypeScript | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ankiforge) | Node 22.13.0, current 22, 24 and 26; 16 public npm installation, ESM/CJS and TypeScript checks |
| Python | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/) | Ordinary CPython 3.11–3.14; 16 isolated public PyPI wheel installation checks |

Published native packages cover macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc and Windows x64. Package availability alone is not a successful runtime test on every host. The [Node coverage](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/COVERAGE.md), [Python coverage](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/python/COVERAGE.md) and release evidence record the exact checks. The successful `0.3.1` release runs are [Rust](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371221696), [npm](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222114) and [PyPI](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222047). Other Python implementations, free-threaded interpreters and subinterpreters need separate validation. Browser, Electron, Bun, Alpine/musl and ARM64 Linux/Windows are outside the recorded Node verification scope.

The [batch media](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/media/#batch-import-from-source) and [prepared publication](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source) guides are available in the public `0.3.1` packages.

## Anki import and playback

Normal export needs no Anki installation. Importing, rendering and playing media still depends on the target client’s version, codecs and import settings. The 2026-10-08 benchmark passed 40 Anki import/content/representative-render checks (20 per implementation), not every client or GUI/audio behavior.

For updates, retain the previous original distribution APKG. Anki re-exports do not retain the required identity evidence. Omitting a note from a package does not delete it from a learner’s collection. Field/template changes, sort fields, local edits and review history require client-specific testing.

Use the [manual client scenarios](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/manual-validation/anki-desktop-v1/TEMPLATE.md) and each oracle’s exact Anki version and settings to evaluate your own distribution. Read [updates](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/) and [build guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/) for client conditions and per-file publication behavior.

# Node and TypeScript API

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/
Language: en
Description: Public methods, async behavior, build options and reports.

The `ankiforge` entry point exposes the sole Project authoring model. Types are defined in [the public source](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/index.ts), [report classes](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/report.ts), and [JSON snapshot declarations](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/snapshots.ts). Start with [the quick start](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/).

## Project and notes

| API | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `new Project(namespace)` | Validate a stable publication namespace |
| `.defaultDeck(name)` | Set the default destination; returns the project |
| `.add(key, note)` | Atomically collect note/model/media; duplicate keys fail |
| `.addAsset(media)` | Include an explicit raw HTML/CSS/script resource |
| `.clone()` | Independent editable project sharing immutable values |
| `.length` | Registered note count |
| `Note.basic(front, back)` / `Note.cloze(text)` | Immutable note holding its built-in model |
| `model.note().field(key, content)` | Immutable custom note holding its model |
| `note.deck(name).tag(tag).tags(iterable)` | Return a newly configured note |

Strings always become Text, including Cloze strings. Explicit markup uses `Content.html`. `Content.sequence(iterable)` combines text, HTML and typed media. Use explicit business keys; neither content nor display names derive identity.

## Immutable models

```js
import { NoteType, Field, Template, GenerationRule } from 'ankiforge';
const model = NoteType.builder('vocabulary')
  .name('词汇')
  .field(new Field('front', { name: '正面', required: true, sort: true }))
  .field(new Field('back', { name: '背面' }))
  .template(new Template('recognition', {
    front: '{{front}}',
    back: '{{FrontSide}}<hr>{{back}}',
    generation: GenerationRule.all(['front']),
  }))
  .build();
const note = model.note().field('front', 'cell').field('back', '细胞');
```

Builders return new values. A completed model has no field/template mutation methods. `builder.clozeField(key)` selects custom Cloze semantics; `builder.css` and `builder.asset` supply styling and explicit dependencies. Templates also accept `name`, `browserFront`, `browserBack` and `targetDeck`. Template references and generation conditions use field keys; display names are compiled for Anki. `GenerationRule.ankiDefault()` selects Anki’s default behavior; `all` and `any` select explicit conditions.

`await NoteType.fromBundle(path, mediaLimits?)` returns the same immutable model from `template-bundle-v2`. Imported text/assets no longer depend on the source directory after success. Models can be reused across projects; incompatible definitions under one model key fail atomically.

## Media and Image Occlusion

`await Media.file(path, limits?)` and `await Media.bytes(Uint8Array, mime, limits?)` return owned snapshots. Source files can change or disappear after the await succeeds. `withExportName(name)` returns a renamed value without changing earlier clones or content. Read `filename`, `mediaType` and `byteLength` as properties.

`media.image()` and `.sound()` return typed Content that automatically brings its asset into a project. Explicit `project.addAsset` and model `builder.asset` cover raw HTML/CSS/script references. Media limits accept `{ maxBytes }`; the default is 256 MiB and native bytes have no 64 KiB inline restriction.

```js
import { Media, Note, Mask } from 'ankiforge';
const image = await Media.file('diagram.png');
const note = Note.imageOcclusion(image)
  .mask(Mask.rect('nucleus', 10, 10, 20, 20))
  .mask(Mask.rect('wall', 50, 50, 20, 20))
  .mode('hide_one_guess_one')
  .build().field('header', 'Cell');
```

The default mode is `hide_all_guess_one`; both modes generate separate cards for keyed masks. `.build()` validates decoded dimensions, finite rectangles and unique keys. `image` and `occlusion` are reserved generated fields. See [Image Occlusion](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/image-occlusion/) for decoding and update limits.

## Build, compare and output

| API | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` | BuildOutput owning persistent artifact |
| `await project.build(BuildOptions.temporary())` | BuildOutput owning temporary artifact |
| `await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` | Completed ComparisonReport, including blocked policy |
| `options.updateFrom(path)` | Configure update from complete original distribution evidence |
| `options.inspectLimits(limits)` | Override independent inspection counters |
| `options.updatePolicy(policy)` | Configure update/compare risk policy |

A successful output exposes `.artifact`, `.report` and `.snapshot()`. The `BuildReport` exposes `.counts`, `.baselineCounts`, `.durationMs`, `.diagnostics`, `.comparison`, and `.snapshot()`; it has no outcome or file ownership. `.comparison` is a `ComparisonReport` or `null`, using the same class as `project.compare()`. Comparisons expose `.findings`, `.highestRisk`, `.policy`, `.diagnostics`, and `.snapshot()`. Snapshot field names mirror Rust JSON, including `allows_publication` and `schema_version`; they are not camel-cased copies of the native report. Use `report.comparison.highestRisk` on a comparison object, or `report.snapshot().comparison.highest_risk` in its JSON snapshot, after checking for `null`.

`new UpdatePolicy()` blocks High/Critical. `.failOn('medium')` changes the threshold. `.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` explicitly accepts that whole category while retaining its evidence and severity. Unknown codes and hard errors cannot be allowed. Policy on a create-only build is an error. Use the same policy and limits in compare and build when you need matching publication decisions.

Inspection options include `maxArchiveBytes`, `maxEntries`, `maxCentralDirectoryBytes`, `maxZipEntryBytes`, `maxZipTotalBytes`, `maxMetaBytes`, `maxMediaMapBytes`, `maxIdentityBytes`, `maxCollectionBytes`, `maxMediaBytes`, `maxDecodedTotalBytes` and `maxZstdWindowBytes`. Values are nonnegative safe integers or `bigint` through u64’s maximum; zero is a real zero budget. Counters apply independently to baseline and candidate. Unknown options fail.

## Artifact lifetime and concurrency

JSON snapshot paths use the exported `PathSnapshot` type. Unicode paths are strings; non-Unicode native paths use `{ encoding: "unix_bytes", bytes: number[] }` or `{ encoding: "windows_wide", units: number[] }`. The arrays preserve the exact Unix bytes or Windows UTF-16 code units. This includes artifact paths in build snapshots, publication paths in failures, and structured error-path details. Decode an encoded path only for its original platform; on Unix, `Buffer.from(value.bytes)` preserves a byte path for Node filesystem functions. The Node authoring methods continue to accept string paths.

Relative media and bundle paths are anchored when the read is invoked; build destinations and baselines are anchored when options are constructed. On POSIX, symbolic links followed by `..` retain filesystem traversal semantics. `persistTo` anchors relative destinations to the working directory captured by the original build, including on cloned and persisted handles. Later working directory changes do not redirect these paths.

Keep an artifact owner alive while consuming `.path`. `.clone()` creates an independent owner; `await .close()` releases that owner. The last temporary owner deletes its file. `await .persistTo(path)` returns a persistent artifact and leaves the original usable even on failure. Standard Node file streams can read an artifact while you retain its owner.

Snapshots are frozen JSON data and retain no native files. A persistent file survives owner cleanup. `BuildOutput` cannot be constructed by the caller; it is created only by successful builds.

Build and compare run asynchronously on an owned project snapshot captured at invocation. Later edits cannot mutate that request. Media reads and bundle loads also run on workers. Node ESM and CJS share the same native module and class identities.

## Errors

`SchemaError`, `AddError`, `MediaError`, `TemplateBundleError`, `ImageOcclusionError`, `PolicyError`, `ConfigurationError`, `CompareError`, `BuildError`, and `PersistError` extend `ForgeError`. They expose `kind`, `code`, `domain`, native source-chain text in `causes`, structured `sourceDetails` for recognized I/O/schema/media/limit causes, and operation `details`. The original native exception is retained as the JS `cause`.

`BuildError.snapshot()` preserves failure and publication facts; `BuildError.report` and `CompareError.report` return `BuildReport`, just like `BuildOutput.report`. Use `.baselineCounts` and `.comparison` on these reports; use `.snapshot()` for the snake\_case JSON fields. A failed comparison can have partial observations and a `null` comparison. `PersistError.publication` records whether the target was already published and whether durability was confirmed. Media/inspection errors retain limit details. Use these machine fields instead of parsing error messages. `ArtifactClosedError` reports use of a closed owner; `NativeLoadError` reports missing, incompatible or stale native packages.

## Addition context

Failed additions leave the project unchanged. Structured context records the original note/model keys and the target, with optional conflict or media usage details. Rust exposes `note::{AddContext, AddTarget, AddDetail}` through `AddError::context()` / `detail()`; SDKs expose `AddError.details` with typed context/detail. Node fields use camelCase and are deeply frozen; Python uses snake\_case TypedDicts. Tags retain their insertion index; field locations retain original sequence indices (null/None for the field, \[\] for its root) and optional UTF-8 byte ranges. Default-deck errors from build have no note/model keys and remain available in the source chain.

Typed images require image/\* MIME at addition; sound references accept audio/\* or video/\*. Other categories raise `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`. Constructors stay infallible; explicit assets and raw HTML are unaffected. The check uses retained import MIME, and does not certify playback. Build’s independent MIME/extension validation still applies. See [the design](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/plans/2026-09-28-rust-api-validation-and-errors-design.md) for the complete target/detail table.

## Batch media and prepared publication

Batch media and prepared publication are included in the public `0.3.1` package.

### Prepare, review and publish

```js
import { Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError } from 'ankiforge';
const project = new Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'));
const previous = await project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'));
await previous.artifact.close();
const prepared = await project.preparePublication(
  BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').updateFrom('previous.apkg'),
);
try {
  const report = prepared.report; // immutable observations, no file ownership
  console.log(report.comparison?.snapshot());
  if (report.comparison?.policy.allows_publication !== false) {
    const output = await prepared.publish();
    await output.artifact.close(); // persistent next.apkg remains
  }
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof BuildError) console.log(error.snapshot().result);
  // Inspect publication/durability facts: a late failure can follow replacement.
  throw error;
} finally {
  await prepared.close(); // idempotent; cleans an unpublished candidate
}
```

`publish()` takes the native owner immediately and performs one worker task. Every attempt consumes it, including policy and I/O rejection. Repeated calls reject with `PreparedPublicationStateError`, code `BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`, and `reason` `consumed` or `closed`. Closing after publish begins does not cancel it. Reports remain readable after close. Options bind at preparation invocation; changing policy or destination requires another preparation. Duration excludes review waiting. Neither reports nor JSON can be converted back into an owner.

Build, compare, preparation and clones share immutable native Project versions. Authoring changes remain synchronous and isolated. The first change while another snapshot lives may copy the Project; later exclusive changes do not. This shifts copying out of Promise submission and does not promise faster first edits, better worst timer delay or lower RSS. JavaScript byte inputs are still copied before worker submission. Use protocol 6 binaries with these wrappers.

## TypeScript

Install `typescript` and `@types/node` in your application. Use `main.mts` or `"type": "module"` and this `tsconfig.json`:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "strict": true,
    "outDir": "dist"
  }
}
```

Compile with `npx tsc`, then run `node dist/main.mjs` for an `.mts` entry.

# Generate Anki flashcards with Node.js

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/
Language: en
Description: Install ankiforge from npm, generate Anki flashcards with Node.js or TypeScript, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.

Use Node.js 22.13 or later. In a new application directory:

```sh
mkdir anki-deck
cd anki-deck
npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1
```

This installs the [public npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ankiforge) and the matching native optional dependency. See [verified environments](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/) for platform coverage.

## Export a deck

Save this as `main.mjs`:

```js
import { Project, Note, BuildOptions } from 'ankiforge';

const project = new Project('spanish').defaultDeck('Spanish');
project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'));
const output = await project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'));
console.log(output.artifact.path);
await output.artifact.close();
```

```sh
node main.mjs
```

Open the persistent `spanish.apkg` in Anki. It contains **hola → hello** in **Spanish**. Keep namespace `spanish` and key `es:hola` stable for later edits. Closing the persistent artifact leaves the file on disk. Exporting does not require Anki to be installed.

## TypeScript and next tasks

The [JSON to Anki recipe](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/json-to-anki/#node) includes a complete TypeScript compile-and-run path.

Use `.mjs` for ESM, or `require('ankiforge')` for CommonJS. TypeScript declarations ship with the package; see [TypeScript configuration](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/#typescript).

-   [Images and audio](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/media/) and [Node media API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/#media-and-image-occlusion)
-   [Custom note types](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/custom-notetypes/) and [template bundles](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/templates/)
-   [Image Occlusion](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/image-occlusion/)
-   [Compare and update](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/)
-   [Node API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/) and [troubleshooting](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/troubleshooting/)

Source builds and local packaging are in [source builds](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/development/).

- [Build Anki decks from code](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/index.md): Choose a language, build your first deck, and learn how to add media, templates and repeatable updates.
- [Choose your language](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/languages/index.md): Install the public Rust, Node or Python package and export your first Anki deck.
- [Compatibility and releases](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/index.md): Published packages, verified environments and Anki client conditions.

## Quickstarts

- [Generate Anki flashcards with Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/quickstart/index.md): Install the public Rust package, write a Spanish flashcard, and export a persistent APKG file.
- [Generate Anki flashcards with Node.js](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/index.md): Install ankiforge from npm, generate Anki flashcards with Node.js or TypeScript, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.
- [Generate Anki flashcards with Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/index.md): Install ankiforge from PyPI, generate Anki flashcards with a short Python script, and export an APKG deck you can import into Anki.

## API references

- [Public API overview](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/api/index.md): Find Rust, Python and Node APIs for authoring, media, diagnostics and updates.
- [Rust API guide](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/rust-api/index.md): Find public authoring methods, build defaults, reports and diagnostic behavior.
- [Node and TypeScript API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-api/index.md): Public methods, async behavior, build options and reports.
- [Python API](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-api/index.md): Project, media, build options, reports and temporary artifact ownership.

## Task guides

- [CSV to Anki: generate flashcards with Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/csv-to-anki/index.md): Convert a UTF-8 vocabulary spreadsheet to an Anki APKG with a complete Python script, sample CSV, stable note IDs and import checks.
- [Generate and update Anki decks from JSON](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/json-to-anki/index.md): Read JSON with Rust, Python or TypeScript, package images and audio, then review an answer-only APKG update.

- [Update Anki decks with stable note IDs](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/index.md): Release a new version of a generated Anki deck: keep stable note IDs, build from the previous original APKG and review the comparison before publishing.

- [Build and output guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/index.md): Understand temporary artifacts, path protection and candidate publication.

- [A note’s identity should outlive its wording](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/blog/stable-ids-and-deck-updates/index.md): Historical article, published 2026-09-22. How stable IDs and a build baseline work together when you update a generated Anki deck.

# Compatibility and releases

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/compatibility/
Language: en
Description: Published packages, verified environments and Anki client conditions.

## Packages and verified environments

Public Rust, npm and PyPI packages are `0.3.1` as checked on 2026-10-13. Start with [Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/installation/), [Node / TypeScript](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/node-quickstart/) or [Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/python-quickstart/).

| Interface | Package | Runtime and verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://crates.io/crates/ankiforge) | Rust 1.92.0 and current stable; packaged consumers on all four supported platforms, plus a fresh public crates.io consumer |
| Node / TypeScript | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ankiforge) | Node 22.13.0, current 22, 24 and 26; 16 public npm installation, ESM/CJS and TypeScript checks |
| Python | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/) | Ordinary CPython 3.11–3.14; 16 isolated public PyPI wheel installation checks |

Published native packages cover macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc and Windows x64. Package availability alone is not a successful runtime test on every host. The [Node coverage](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/COVERAGE.md), [Python coverage](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/python/COVERAGE.md) and release evidence record the exact checks. The successful `0.3.1` release runs are [Rust](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371221696), [npm](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222114) and [PyPI](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222047). Other Python implementations, free-threaded interpreters and subinterpreters need separate validation. Browser, Electron, Bun, Alpine/musl and ARM64 Linux/Windows are outside the recorded Node verification scope.

The [batch media](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/media/#batch-import-from-source) and [prepared publication](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source) guides are available in the public `0.3.1` packages.

## Anki import and playback

Normal export needs no Anki installation. Importing, rendering and playing media still depends on the target client’s version, codecs and import settings. The 2026-10-08 benchmark passed 40 Anki import/content/representative-render checks (20 per implementation), not every client or GUI/audio behavior.

For updates, retain the previous original distribution APKG. Anki re-exports do not retain the required identity evidence. Omitting a note from a package does not delete it from a learner’s collection. Field/template changes, sort fields, local edits and review history require client-specific testing.

Use the [manual client scenarios](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/manual-validation/anki-desktop-v1/TEMPLATE.md) and each oracle’s exact Anki version and settings to evaluate your own distribution. Read [updates](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/) and [build guarantees](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/) for client conditions and per-file publication behavior.

# Build and output guarantees

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/build-guarantees/
Language: en
Description: Understand temporary artifacts, path protection and candidate publication.

`Project::build` returns `BuildOutput` only after a successful operation, with a guaranteed APKG artifact. A failed operation returns `BuildError` with structured kind/code, observations, underlying causes and actual publication facts.

## Temporary and persistent artifacts

Choose the ownership model explicitly:

| Request | Ownership |
| --- | --- |
| `BuildOptions::to(path)` | Persistent destination; survives handle cleanup |
| `BuildOptions::temporary()` | Temporary file; deleted with its last artifact owner |
| `artifact.persist_to(path)` | New persistent owner; original owner remains usable |

Keep the `BuildOutput` or a cloned artifact alive while reading a temporary path. A report or JSON snapshot does not extend file lifetime. Rust drops owners normally; Node exposes `artifact.close()` for deterministic release. Copying the path into application state does not create an owner.

Rust artifact handles retain absolute paths, including when the build or `persist_to` uses a relative destination. Later changes to the process working directory do not redirect reads or copies from an existing handle. Each new `persist_to` destination is resolved against the directory at that call.

`BuildReport::snapshot()` contains only observations. `BuildOutput::snapshot()` and `BuildError::snapshot()` additionally state the real outcome. A warning can appear in a successful snapshot. Do not infer outcome from diagnostic severity, a path’s existence, or whether a report has comparison findings.

## Baselines and publication

For updates, retain the previous original distribution APKG as an immutable baseline and choose a separate output destination. Baseline evidence and candidate content are checked before publication. Policy rejection does not replace the output. Missing or corrupt evidence and exhausted inspection budgets are hard failures.

Publication uses atomic replacement of the APKG. This is a per-file guarantee; writing an application’s separate JSON report is a separate operation. The ordinary build does not write an additional identity file: complete versioned evidence is embedded in the distribution package.

A late error can occur after publication, for example while confirming persistence. Error snapshots therefore record `PublicationSnapshot` facts: `path`, `stage` (`not_published` or `published`), `temporary`, and durability (`confirmed` or `unconfirmed`). Check these facts before retrying or announcing that no file was written. `PersistError` also preserves its publication fact and actual I/O source. Atomic replacement alone does not establish durability after a crash.

Snapshot serialization preserves native paths without accessing the filesystem. Unicode paths remain JSON strings. Non-UTF-8 Unix paths use `{"encoding":"unix_bytes","bytes":[...]}`; Windows paths with unpaired UTF-16 surrogates use `{"encoding":"windows_wide","units":[...]}`. The arrays contain the exact native bytes or code units. Success artifact paths, failure publication paths, and binding error-path details all use this representation. These values describe paths and do not retain artifact ownership. A filesystem may reject a particular native path, but its publication failure facts remain serializable.

## Inspection limits

Finite archive, entry-count, expansion, decoded collection/media and zstd-window budgets apply independently to baseline and candidate. Start with `InspectLimits::default()` and deliberately raise a relevant limit when needed. A limit of zero is not unlimited. These counters are not a process-wide memory or CPU sandbox; media imports have a separate earlier per-asset budget.

## Concurrent work

Rust builds borrow immutable project state. Owned models and media can be shared across projects. The Node binding captures a project snapshot when build or compare is invoked, so later additions do not change that request. Retain the artifact owner until all readers have finished; closing the last temporary owner while a separate consumer still needs its path is an application lifetime error.

Package inspection cannot establish every client-side behavior. Test rendering, playback and update imports with the intended Anki versions and settings. See [updates](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/) for scheduling and schema-change limits.

## Prepared publication from source

Prepared publication is included in the public `0.3.1` packages.

`prepare_publication` builds, inspects and compares one private candidate; `publish` uses that same file. Options and relative destinations bind at preparation. Project edits cannot alter the candidate. Preparation alone does not replace the destination; dropping or closing an unpublished owner removes it.

Every publish attempt consumes the owner, including policy or I/O failure. Reprepare to retry or change the policy/destination. Reports remain readable and own no files. Node/Python expose idempotent `close()` and an unavailable error with `closed` or `consumed` reason; closing after publication starts does not cancel it. Duration excludes review waiting. A late durability failure can follow successful replacement, so inspect the actual publication facts.

Follow the [complete example](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source) and the language API references for typed errors and worker behavior.

# 用 Python 生成 Anki 卡片

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-quickstart/
Language: zh-CN
Description: 从 PyPI 安装 ankiforge，用简短的 Python 脚本生成 Anki 问答卡片，并导出可导入 Anki 的 APKG 牌组。

创建并激活虚拟环境，然后安装[公开 PyPI 包](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/)：

```sh
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1
```

Windows 使用 `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1` 激活。使用普通 CPython 3.11 或更高版本及匹配的平台 wheel；已有发布检查覆盖 CPython 3.11–3.14，参见[已验证环境](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/compatibility/)。

## 导出牌组

将以下程序保存为 `main.py`：

```python
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions

project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')
project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))
output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))
print(output.artifact.path)
```

```sh
python main.py
```

在 Anki 中打开持久保存的 `spanish.apkg`，其中 **Spanish** 牌组包含 **hola → hello**。后续编辑时保持命名空间 `spanish` 和笔记键 `es:hola` 不变。导出不需要安装 Anki。

## 继续学习

已有词汇表时，参考 [CSV 转 Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/csv-to-anki/)。需要根据原始笔记起草卡片时， 可从 [AI 辅助制卡](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/ai-anki-cards/)开始。

# Python API

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-api/
Language: zh-CN
Description: Project、媒体、构建选项、报告和临时产物的所有权。

SDK 通过原生扩展调用默认 Rust 公开 API，包含 `py.typed` 和经过检查的公开签名。从[入门](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-quickstart/)开始。

## Project 与笔记值

| 入口 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `Project(namespace, *, default_deck=None)` | 校验显式稳定命名空间并配置默认牌组 |
| `project.add(key, note)` | 原子收集笔记、模型及拥有所有权的媒体；重复笔记键失败 |
| `project.add_asset(media)` | 包含显式原始 HTML/CSS/脚本依赖 |
| `len(project)` | 成功添加的笔记数 |
| `Note.basic(front, back)` | 内置 Basic 模型；字符串表示 Text |
| `Note.cloze(text)` | 内置 Cloze 模型；字符串表示 Text 并保留填空语法 |
| `note.field(key, content)` | 返回已赋值的新笔记；添加时校验键 |
| `note.deck(name)` / `.tag(tag)` / `.tags(tags)` | 返回配置后的笔记 |
| `note.note_type` | 拥有所有权的不可变模型 |

普通字符串成为 Text。`Content.text(value)` 和 `Content.html(value)` 是显式构造函数；`Content.sequence(iterable)` 组合字符串与内容，不预先渲染或丢失媒体依赖。字段不接受原始文件名作为媒体引用。

## 模型与模板

`NoteType.builder(key)` 返回不可变构建器。`.name`、`.field`、`.template`、`.css`、`.cloze_field` 与 `.asset` 返回更新的构建器。`.build()` 校验完整定义并返回不可变 NoteType。`model.note()` 创建拥有该模型的笔记。`NoteType.from_bundle(path, limits=MediaLimits())` 从当前模板包格式加载相同模型及资源；可选预算在读取前分别应用于每个资源。

`Field(key, name=None, required=False, sort=False)` 分离稳定键与显示名称。`Template(key, front, back, name=None, browser_front=None, browser_back=None, target_deck=None, generation=GenerationRule())` 的每个源字符串使用字段键。`GenerationRule.all(keys)` 和 `.any(keys)` 配置卡片生成，默认推断 Anki 的字段存在条件。构建器的 `.cloze_field(key)` 声明自定义填空生成。

## 媒体与遮挡

| 入口 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `Media.file(path, *, limits=MediaLimits())` | 立即读取拥有所有权的快照 |
| `Media.bytes(data, media_type, *, limits=MediaLimits())` | 拥有带显式 MIME 类型的字节 |
| `media.with_export_name(name)` | 返回共享快照的新文件名值；之前的引用保留原名 |
| `media.filename`, `media.media_type`, `len(media)` | 只读快照元数据 |
| `media.image()` / `.sound()` | 保留快照的类型化内容 |

`MediaLimits(max_bytes=256 << 20)` 在创建快照前控制每次导入。大媒体可写入拥有所有权的临时存储。名称冲突在全部显式与自动收集资源间校验。

`Note.image_occlusion(media)` 返回 ImageOcclusionBuilder。链式调用 `.mask(Mask.rect(key, x, y, width, height))`、可选 `.mode(OcclusionMode.HIDE_ONE_GUESS_ONE)`，再调用 `.build()`。默认模式为 `HIDE_ALL_GUESS_ONE`。完成时解码图像，并校验稳定遮罩键和有限、位于图内的像素坐标。在返回的 Note 上可正常设置 `header`、`back_extra` 或 `comments`。生成的 `image` 与 `occlusion` 字段不能手动赋值。

## 操作与结果

| 入口 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` | 保证有持久产物的 BuildOutput |
| `project.build(BuildOptions.temporary())` | 拥有临时产物的 BuildOutput |
| `options.update_from(path)` | 返回基于完整基线证据更新的选项 |
| `project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` | 完成的 ComparisonReport，含独立发布策略决定 |
| `options.update_policy(policy)` | 为 Update/Compare 应用显式风险策略；Create 不适用 |
| `options.inspect_limits(limits)` | 为基线与候选包分别应用有限限制 |

BuildOutput 提供 `.artifact`、`.report` 和 `.snapshot()`。BuildReport 提供 `.counts`（含 notes/cards/media 的 BuildCounts）、`.diagnostics`、`.comparison` 和 `.snapshot()`。报告没有操作结果或文件所有者。ComparisonReport 提供 `.findings`、`.policy`、`.allows_publication` 与 `.snapshot()`。快照是普通可 JSON 序列化字典，不含产物所有权。

ApkgArtifact 提供 `.path`、`.persist_to(path)` 和 `.close()`。使用 `copy.copy` 复制会保留另一个所有者；上下文管理器在退出时释放该所有者。最后一个所有者释放后，临时输出消失。持久路径在句柄清理后仍存在。持久化失败不影响源句柄继续使用。

`UpdatePolicy()` 阻止 High 和 Critical 发现项。`.fail_on(RiskLevel.MEDIUM)` 改变阈值。`.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` 显式接受整个已注册类别，保留证据。未知码立即失败。`InspectLimits` 提供全部有限字节或数量预算，包括 `max_identity_bytes`；不能禁用必需检查。

## 错误与并发

失败抛出 SchemaError、AddError、MediaError、ImageOcclusionError、TemplateBundleError、CompareError、PolicyError、BuildError 或 PersistError。它们提供 `kind`、`code`、`details`、`source_details` 中的结构化观察结果和 `causes` 中的来源链文本，并将原生异常保留为 `__cause__`。可用时 I/O 原因保留链接的 OSError。BuildError 提供 `.report` 和 `.snapshot()`；CompareError 提供部分 `.report`；PersistError 详情包含实际发布事实。

原生 Project 操作释放 GIL，并以 `BINDING.PROJECT_BUSY` 拒绝同时使用同一对象；独立项目可并发运行。进程 fork 后重新创建全部原生值与句柄。继承的句柄以 `BINDING.FORKED_OBJECT` 拒绝操作，其清理不能删除父进程拥有的文件。子进程创建的值可正常操作和清理。参见[诊断](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-diagnostics/)。

## 添加上下文

添加失败不会改变项目。结构化上下文记录原始笔记或模型键和目标，并可附带冲突或媒体用法详情。Rust 通过 `AddError::context()` / `detail()` 提供 `note::{AddContext, AddTarget, AddDetail}`；SDK 通过 `AddError.details` 提供类型化 context/detail。Node 字段使用 camelCase 且深度冻结；Python 使用 snake\_case TypedDict。标签保留插入下标；字段位置保留原始序列下标（null/None 指字段，\[\] 指其根）以及可选 UTF-8 字节范围。构建产生的默认牌组错误不带笔记或模型键，仍可从来源链读取。

添加时，类型化图片要求 image/\* MIME，声音引用接受 audio/\* 或 video/\*。其他类别产生 `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`。构造函数保持不会失败；显式资源和原始 HTML 不受影响。检查使用导入时保留的 MIME，不认证播放能力。构建的独立 MIME/扩展名校验仍然适用。完整 target/detail 表见[设计](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/plans/2026-09-28-rust-api-validation-and-errors-design.md)。

## 源码 API 详情

批量媒体与预备发布已包含在公开 `0.3.1` 包中。

### 预备、审阅与发布

```python
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError
project = Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'))
previous = project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'))
previous.artifact.close()
prepared = project.prepare_publication(
    BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').update_from('previous.apkg')
)
try:
    report = prepared.report  # observations; does not own the candidate
    if report.comparison is None or report.comparison.allows_publication:
        output = prepared.publish()
        output.artifact.close()  # persistent next.apkg remains
except BuildError as error:
    print(error.snapshot()['result'])  # actual publication/durability facts
    raise
finally:
    prepared.close()  # idempotent; deletes an unused candidate
```

一次发布尝试消耗所有者，包括策略或 I/O 失败。之后调用抛出 `PreparedPublicationStateError`，码为 `BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`，原因是 `closed` 或 `consumed`；close 不取消已经运行的发布。相对路径在预备调用时绑定，Project 更改不能修改已审阅 APKG。报告关闭后仍可读，但不保留文件。改变选项或重试需重新预备。耗时不含审阅等待。晚期错误可能表示替换成功但持久性未确认；决定下一步前检查发布事实。要求原生绑定协议 1 和契约包 2.1.0；更旧的同版本二进制会被拒绝。

# 兼容性与发布

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/compatibility/
Language: zh-CN
Description: 查看公开包、已验证运行环境和 Anki 客户端条件。

## 公开包与已验证环境

截至 2026-10-13，公开 Rust、npm 和 PyPI 包均为 `0.3.1`。从 [Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/installation/)、[Node / TypeScript](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/node-quickstart/) 或 [Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-quickstart/) 开始。

| 接口 | 包 | 运行环境与验证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://crates.io/crates/ankiforge) | Rust 1.92.0 与当前稳定版；四个支持平台的打包消费者，以及全新的公开 crates.io 消费者 |
| Node / TypeScript | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ankiforge) | Node 22.13.0、当前 22、24 和 26；16 项公开 npm 安装、ESM/CJS 和 TypeScript 检查 |
| Python | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/) | 普通 CPython 3.11–3.14；16 项隔离的公开 PyPI wheel 安装检查 |

已发布的原生包覆盖 macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64 GNU/glibc 和 Windows x64。存在安装包并不等于在每台主机上都通过了运行测试。[Node 覆盖记录](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/COVERAGE.md)、[Python 覆盖记录](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/python/COVERAGE.md)和发布证据列出具体检查。成功的 `0.3.1` 发布运行分别为 [Rust](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371221696)、[npm](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222114) 和 [PyPI](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222047)。其他 Python 实现、自由线程解释器与子解释器需要单独验证。浏览器、Electron、Bun、Alpine/musl 以及 ARM64 Linux/Windows 不在现有 Node 验证范围内。

[批量媒体](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/media/#batch-import-from-source)和[预备发布](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source)指南中的能力已包含在公开 `0.3.1` 包中。

## Anki 导入与播放

普通导出不需要安装 Anki。导入、渲染和播放媒体仍取决于目标客户端版本、编解码器和导入设置。2026-10-08 的基准测试通过了 40 项 Anki 导入、内容和代表性渲染检查（每个实现 20 项），并未覆盖所有客户端或 GUI/音频行为。

更新时保留之前的原始分发 APKG。Anki 重新导出的文件不保留所需身份证据。包中不再包含某条笔记，并不会将其从学习者的集合中删除。字段或模板变化、排序字段、本地编辑和复习历史需要针对客户端测试。

使用[手动客户端场景](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/manual-validation/anki-desktop-v1/TEMPLATE.md)及各 oracle 记录的具体 Anki 版本和设置评估自己的分发。客户端条件与单文件发布行为见[更新](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/)和[构建保证](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/)。

> Anki Forge 使用 Rust、Node / TypeScript 或 Python 从代码生成 Anki APKG 牌组。

当前公开包版本：0.3.1。 正常导出无需安装 Anki。公开包 API 与源码构建不同。更新时保留上一份原始分发 APKG；Anki 导入设置和较新的本地修改可能影响结果。

- Node / TypeScript: `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` (Node.js 22.13+)
- Python: `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+)

- [用代码生成 Anki 牌组](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/index.md): 选择开发语言，生成第一个牌组，再添加媒体、模板和可重复的更新。

# Node 与 TypeScript API

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/node-api/
Language: zh-CN
Description: 公开方法、异步行为、构建选项和报告。

`ankiforge` 入口提供唯一的 Project 内容编写模型。类型定义位于[公开源码](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/index.ts)、[报告类](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/report.ts)及 [JSON 快照声明](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/src/snapshots.ts)。从[入门](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/node-quickstart/)开始。

## Project 与笔记

| API | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `new Project(namespace)` | 校验稳定发布命名空间 |
| `.defaultDeck(name)` | 设置默认目标；返回项目 |
| `.add(key, note)` | 原子收集笔记、模型和媒体；重复键失败 |
| `.addAsset(media)` | 包含显式原始 HTML/CSS/脚本资源 |
| `.clone()` | 独立可编辑项目，共享不可变值 |
| `.length` | 已注册笔记数 |
| `Note.basic(front, back)` / `Note.cloze(text)` | 持有内置模型的不可变笔记 |
| `model.note().field(key, content)` | 持有模型的不可变自定义笔记 |
| `note.deck(name).tag(tag).tags(iterable)` | 返回重新配置的笔记 |

字符串始终成为 Text，包括 Cloze 字符串。显式标记使用 `Content.html`。`Content.sequence(iterable)` 组合文本、HTML 与类型化媒体。使用显式业务键；内容和显示名称都不会派生身份。

## 不可变模型

```js
import { NoteType, Field, Template, GenerationRule } from 'ankiforge';
const model = NoteType.builder('vocabulary')
  .name('词汇')
  .field(new Field('front', { name: '正面', required: true, sort: true }))
  .field(new Field('back', { name: '背面' }))
  .template(new Template('recognition', {
    front: '{{front}}',
    back: '{{FrontSide}}<hr>{{back}}',
    generation: GenerationRule.all(['front']),
  }))
  .build();
const note = model.note().field('front', 'cell').field('back', '细胞');
```

构建器返回新值。完成的模型没有修改字段或模板的方法。`builder.clozeField(key)` 选择自定义 Cloze 语义；`builder.css` 与 `builder.asset` 提供样式和显式依赖。模板还接受 `name`、`browserFront`、`browserBack` 和 `targetDeck`。模板引用及生成条件使用字段键，显示名称编译后供 Anki 使用。`GenerationRule.ankiDefault()` 选择 Anki 默认行为；`all` 和 `any` 选择显式条件。

`await NoteType.fromBundle(path, mediaLimits?)` 从 `template-bundle-v2` 返回相同的不可变模型。成功后导入文本和资源不再依赖源目录。模型可跨项目复用；同一模型键下不兼容的定义会原子地失败。

## 媒体与图片遮挡

`await Media.file(path, limits?)` 和 `await Media.bytes(Uint8Array, mime, limits?)` 返回拥有所有权的快照。await 成功后源文件可改变或消失。`withExportName(name)` 返回重命名值，不改变之前的克隆或内容。通过属性读取 `filename`、`mediaType` 和 `byteLength`。

`media.image()` 与 `.sound()` 返回自动将资源带入项目的类型化 Content。显式 `project.addAsset` 与模型 `builder.asset` 处理原始 HTML/CSS/脚本引用。媒体限制接受 `{ maxBytes }`，默认为 256 MiB；原生字节没有 64 KiB 内联限制。

```js
import { Media, Note, Mask } from 'ankiforge';
const image = await Media.file('diagram.png');
const note = Note.imageOcclusion(image)
  .mask(Mask.rect('nucleus', 10, 10, 20, 20))
  .mask(Mask.rect('wall', 50, 50, 20, 20))
  .mode('hide_one_guess_one')
  .build().field('header', 'Cell');
```

默认模式为 `hide_all_guess_one`；两种模式都为带键遮罩生成独立卡片。`.build()` 校验解码尺寸、有限矩形和唯一键。`image` 与 `occlusion` 是保留的生成字段。解码与更新限制见[图片遮挡](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/image-occlusion/)。

## 构建、比较与输出

| API | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` | 拥有持久产物的 BuildOutput |
| `await project.build(BuildOptions.temporary())` | 拥有临时产物的 BuildOutput |
| `await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` | 完成的 ComparisonReport，包括被阻止的策略 |
| `options.updateFrom(path)` | 配置基于完整原始分发证据的更新 |
| `options.inspectLimits(limits)` | 覆盖独立检查计数器 |
| `options.updatePolicy(policy)` | 配置更新/比较风险策略 |

成功输出提供 `.artifact`、`.report` 与 `.snapshot()`。`BuildReport` 提供 `.counts`、`.baselineCounts`、`.durationMs`、`.diagnostics`、`.comparison` 和 `.snapshot()`；没有结果或文件所有权。`.comparison` 是 `ComparisonReport` 或 `null`，与 `project.compare()` 使用同一类。比较对象提供 `.findings`、`.highestRisk`、`.policy`、`.diagnostics` 和 `.snapshot()`。快照字段名对应 Rust JSON，包括 `allows_publication` 与 `schema_version`，并非原生报告的 camelCase 副本。检查非 `null` 后，在比较对象上使用 `report.comparison.highestRisk`，在 JSON 快照中使用 `report.snapshot().comparison.highest_risk`。

`new UpdatePolicy()` 阻止 High/Critical。`.failOn('medium')` 改变阈值。`.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` 显式接受整个类别，保留证据和严重程度。未知码和硬错误不能放行。仅新建构建上设置策略会报错。需要相同发布决策时，对 compare 和 build 使用相同策略与限制。

检查选项包括 `maxArchiveBytes`、`maxEntries`、`maxCentralDirectoryBytes`、`maxZipEntryBytes`、`maxZipTotalBytes`、`maxMetaBytes`、`maxMediaMapBytes`、`maxIdentityBytes`、`maxCollectionBytes`、`maxMediaBytes`、`maxDecodedTotalBytes` 和 `maxZstdWindowBytes`。值可为非负安全整数，或不超过 u64 最大值的 `bigint`；零是实际零预算。计数器独立应用于基线与候选包。未知选项失败。

## 产物寿命与并发

JSON 快照路径使用导出的 `PathSnapshot` 类型。Unicode 路径为字符串；非 Unicode 原生路径使用 `{ encoding: "unix_bytes", bytes: number[] }` 或 `{ encoding: "windows_wide", units: number[] }`。数组保留精确的 Unix 字节或 Windows UTF-16 代码单元，适用于构建快照中的产物路径、失败发布路径及结构化错误路径详情。只在原平台解码路径；Unix 中 `Buffer.from(value.bytes)` 为 Node 文件系统函数保留字节路径。Node 内容编写方法仍接受字符串路径。

相对媒体和模板包路径在调用读取时锚定；构建目标和基线在构建选项时锚定。POSIX 中，符号链接后接 `..` 保留文件系统遍历语义。`persistTo` 将相对目标锚定到原构建捕获的工作目录，包括克隆和持久化句柄。之后的工作目录变化不会重定向这些路径。

消费 `.path` 时保持产物所有者存活。`.clone()` 创建独立所有者；`await .close()` 释放该所有者。最后一个临时所有者删除文件。`await .persistTo(path)` 返回持久产物，失败时原所有者也仍可用。保留所有者期间，标准 Node 文件流可以读取产物。

快照是冻结的 JSON 数据，不保留原生文件。持久文件在所有者清理后仍存在。调用方不能构造 `BuildOutput`；它只由成功构建创建。

Build 与 compare 异步运行，使用调用时捕获并拥有所有权的项目快照。后续编辑不能改变该请求。媒体读取和模板包加载也在工作线程上执行。Node ESM 与 CJS 共享相同原生模块和类身份。

## 错误

`SchemaError`、`AddError`、`MediaError`、`TemplateBundleError`、`ImageOcclusionError`、`PolicyError`、`ConfigurationError`、`CompareError`、`BuildError` 和 `PersistError` 继承 `ForgeError`。它们提供 `kind`、`code`、`domain`、`causes` 中的原生来源链文本、用于已识别 I/O/schema/媒体/限制原因的结构化 `sourceDetails`，以及操作 `details`。原始原生异常保留为 JS `cause`。

`BuildError.snapshot()` 保留失败与发布事实。`BuildError.report` 和 `CompareError.report` 与 `BuildOutput.report` 一样返回 `BuildReport`。报告使用 `.baselineCounts` 和 `.comparison`；snake\_case JSON 字段通过 `.snapshot()` 访问。失败比较可能只有部分观察结果，且 comparison 为 `null`。`PersistError.publication` 记录目标是否已发布、持久性是否确认。媒体或检查错误保留限制详情。请使用机器字段，不解析错误消息。`ArtifactClosedError` 表示使用已关闭所有者；`NativeLoadError` 表示原生包缺失、不兼容或陈旧。

## 添加上下文

添加失败不会改变项目。结构化上下文记录原始笔记或模型键和目标，并可附带冲突或媒体用法详情。Rust 通过 `AddError::context()` / `detail()` 提供 `note::{AddContext, AddTarget, AddDetail}`；SDK 通过 `AddError.details` 提供类型化 context/detail。Node 字段使用 camelCase 且深度冻结；Python 使用 snake\_case TypedDict。标签保留插入下标；字段位置保留原始序列下标（null/None 指字段，\[\] 指其根）以及可选 UTF-8 字节范围。构建产生的默认牌组错误不带笔记或模型键，仍可从来源链读取。

添加时，类型化图片要求 image/\* MIME，声音引用接受 audio/\* 或 video/\*。其他类别产生 `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`。构造函数保持不会失败；显式资源和原始 HTML 不受影响。检查使用导入时保留的 MIME，不认证播放能力。构建的独立 MIME/扩展名校验仍然适用。完整 target/detail 表见[设计](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/plans/2026-09-28-rust-api-validation-and-errors-design.md)。

## 批量媒体与预备发布

批量媒体与预备发布已包含在公开 `0.3.1` 包中。

### 预备、审阅与发布

```js
import { Project, Note, BuildOptions, BuildError } from 'ankiforge';
const project = new Project('review-once').add('one', Note.basic('Question', 'Answer'));
const previous = await project.build(BuildOptions.to('previous.apkg'));
await previous.artifact.close();
const prepared = await project.preparePublication(
  BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').updateFrom('previous.apkg'),
);
try {
  const report = prepared.report; // immutable observations, no file ownership
  console.log(report.comparison?.snapshot());
  if (report.comparison?.policy.allows_publication !== false) {
    const output = await prepared.publish();
    await output.artifact.close(); // persistent next.apkg remains
  }
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof BuildError) console.log(error.snapshot().result);
  // Inspect publication/durability facts: a late failure can follow replacement.
  throw error;
} finally {
  await prepared.close(); // idempotent; cleans an unpublished candidate
}
```

`publish()` 立即取得原生所有者并执行一个工作线程任务。每次尝试都会消耗它，包括策略或 I/O 拒绝。重复调用以 `PreparedPublicationStateError` 拒绝，码为 `BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`，`reason` 为 `consumed` 或 `closed`。发布开始后关闭不会取消它。关闭后报告仍可读。选项在预备调用时绑定；改变策略或目标需要重新预备。耗时不含审阅等待。报告和 JSON 都不能转换回所有者。

构建、比较、预备和克隆共享不可变原生 Project 版本。内容编写更改仍同步且隔离。当另一快照存活时，第一次更改可能复制 Project；之后独占更改不会。这将复制移出 Promise 提交阶段，但不承诺首次编辑更快、最差定时器延迟更好或 RSS 更低。JavaScript 字节输入仍在提交工作线程前复制。此包装层使用协议 6 二进制。

## TypeScript

在应用中安装 `typescript` 和 `@types/node`。使用 `main.mts` 或 `"type": "module"`，以及以下 `tsconfig.json`：

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "strict": true,
    "outDir": "dist"
  }
}
```

使用 `npx tsc` 编译；`.mts` 入口随后运行 `node dist/main.mjs`。

```sh
mkdir anki-deck
```

```js
import { Project, Note, BuildOptions } from 'ankiforge';

project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'));
const output = await project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'));
console.log(output.artifact.path);
await output.artifact.close();
```

```sh
node main.mjs
```

# 兼容性与发布

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/compatibility/
Language: zh-CN
Description: 查看公开包、已验证运行环境和 Anki 客户端条件。

## 公开包与已验证环境

截至 2026-10-13，公开 Rust、npm 和 PyPI 包均为 `0.3.1`。从 [Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/installation/)、[Node / TypeScript](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/node-quickstart/) 或 [Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/python-quickstart/) 开始。

| 接口 | 包 | 运行环境与验证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://crates.io/crates/ankiforge) | Rust 1.92.0 与当前稳定版；四个支持平台的打包消费者，以及全新的公开 crates.io 消费者 |
| Node / TypeScript | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ankiforge) | Node 22.13.0、当前 22、24 和 26；16 项公开 npm 安装、ESM/CJS 和 TypeScript 检查 |
| Python | [ankiforge 0.3.1](https://pypi.org/project/ankiforge/) | 普通 CPython 3.11–3.14；16 项隔离的公开 PyPI wheel 安装检查 |

已发布的原生包覆盖 macOS arm64/x64、Linux x64 GNU/glibc 和 Windows x64。存在安装包并不等于在每台主机上都通过了运行测试。[Node 覆盖记录](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/node/COVERAGE.md)、[Python 覆盖记录](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/bindings/python/COVERAGE.md)和发布证据列出具体检查。成功的 `0.3.1` 发布运行分别为 [Rust](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371221696)、[npm](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222114) 和 [PyPI](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/actions/runs/38371222047)。其他 Python 实现、自由线程解释器与子解释器需要单独验证。浏览器、Electron、Bun、Alpine/musl 以及 ARM64 Linux/Windows 不在现有 Node 验证范围内。

[批量媒体](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/media/#batch-import-from-source)和[预备发布](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source)指南中的能力已包含在公开 `0.3.1` 包中。

## Anki 导入与播放

普通导出不需要安装 Anki。导入、渲染和播放媒体仍取决于目标客户端版本、编解码器和导入设置。2026-10-08 的基准测试通过了 40 项 Anki 导入、内容和代表性渲染检查（每个实现 20 项），并未覆盖所有客户端或 GUI/音频行为。

更新时保留之前的原始分发 APKG。Anki 重新导出的文件不保留所需身份证据。包中不再包含某条笔记，并不会将其从学习者的集合中删除。字段或模板变化、排序字段、本地编辑和复习历史需要针对客户端测试。

使用[手动客户端场景](https://github.com/morehardy/anki-forge/blob/main/docs/manual-validation/anki-desktop-v1/TEMPLATE.md)及各 oracle 记录的具体 Anki 版本和设置评估自己的分发。客户端条件与单文件发布行为见[更新](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/)和[构建保证](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/)。

# 构建与输出保证

Canonical page: https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/
Language: zh-CN
Description: 理解临时产物、路径保护和候选版本发布。

`Project::build` 只在操作成功后返回 `BuildOutput`，并保证其中有 APKG 产物。失败时返回 `BuildError`，包含结构化 kind/code、观察结果、底层原因和实际发布事实。

## 临时与持久产物

显式选择所有权模型：

| 请求 | 所有权 |
| --- | --- |
| `BuildOptions::to(path)` | 持久目标；句柄清理后仍保留 |
| `BuildOptions::temporary()` | 临时文件；随最后一个产物所有者删除 |
| `artifact.persist_to(path)` | 新的持久所有者；原所有者仍可使用 |

读取临时路径时，保持 `BuildOutput` 或克隆的产物存活。报告或 JSON 快照不会延长文件寿命。Rust 正常释放所有者；Node 提供 `artifact.close()` 以确定性释放。把路径复制到应用状态中不会创建所有者。

Rust 产物句柄保留绝对路径，即使构建或 `persist_to` 使用相对目标。之后改变进程工作目录不会重定向从已有句柄进行的读取或复制。每个新 `persist_to` 目标均相对于调用时的目录解析。

`BuildReport::snapshot()` 只有观察结果。`BuildOutput::snapshot()` 和 `BuildError::snapshot()` 还说明真实结果。成功快照中也可能有警告。不要从诊断严重程度、路径是否存在或报告是否包含比较发现项来推断结果。

## 基线与发布

更新时保留之前的原始分发 APKG 作为不可变基线，并选择独立输出目标。发布前检查基线证据和候选内容。策略拒绝不会替换输出。缺失或损坏的证据、检查预算耗尽均为硬失败。

发布通过原子替换 APKG 完成。这是单文件保证；写入应用自己的独立 JSON 报告属于另一次操作。普通构建不写额外身份文件：完整的带版本证据嵌入分发包。

发布后仍可能发生晚期错误，例如确认持久性时出错。因此错误快照记录 `PublicationSnapshot` 事实：`path`、`stage`（`not_published` 或 `published`）、`temporary`，以及持久性（`confirmed` 或 `unconfirmed`）。重试或声称没有写入文件前，应检查这些事实。`PersistError` 同样保留发布事实和实际 I/O 源。仅原子替换并不能证明崩溃后的持久性。

快照序列化保留原生路径，不访问文件系统。Unicode 路径仍为 JSON 字符串。非 UTF-8 Unix 路径使用 `{"encoding":"unix_bytes","bytes":[...]}`；含未配对 UTF-16 代理项的 Windows 路径使用 `{"encoding":"windows_wide","units":[...]}`。数组保存精确的原生字节或代码单元。成功产物路径、失败发布路径和绑定错误路径详情均使用此表示。它们描述路径，但不保留产物所有权。文件系统可能拒绝特定原生路径，但其发布失败事实仍可序列化。

## 检查限制

有限的归档大小、条目数量、展开大小、解码集合或媒体及 zstd 窗口预算，分别独立应用于基线与候选包。从 `InspectLimits::default()` 开始，确有需要时再有意提高相关限制。零不是无限制。这些计数器并非进程级内存或 CPU 沙箱；媒体导入另有更早执行的单资源预算。

## 并发工作

Rust 构建借用不可变项目状态。拥有所有权的模型和媒体可跨项目共享。Node 绑定在调用 build 或 compare 时捕获项目快照，之后的添加不会改变该请求。保持产物所有者存活，直到全部读取者结束；另一个消费者仍需路径时关闭最后一个临时所有者，是应用的生命周期错误。

包检查不能证明所有客户端行为。请使用目标 Anki 版本和设置测试渲染、播放与更新导入。调度与 schema 更改限制见[更新](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/)。

## 源码中的预备发布

预备发布已包含在公开 `0.3.1` 包中。

`prepare_publication` 构建、检查并比较一个私有候选包；`publish` 使用同一文件。选项和相对目标在预备阶段绑定。项目编辑不会改变候选包。仅预备不会替换目标；释放或关闭未发布的所有者会移除候选包。

每次发布尝试都会消耗所有者，包括策略或 I/O 失败。重试或改变策略、目标需要重新预备。报告仍可读取，但不拥有文件。Node/Python 提供幂等 `close()`，以及原因是 `closed` 或 `consumed` 的不可用错误；发布开始后关闭不会取消它。耗时不包含等待审阅的时间。成功替换后仍可能发生晚期持久性失败，因此要检查实际发布事实。

完整操作见[示例](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/zh-cn/docs/updates/#build-once-review-then-publish-from-source)，类型化错误和工作线程行为见各语言 API 参考。

# Anki Forge

> Anki Forge genera mazos APKG de Anki a partir de código en Rust, Node.js/TypeScript o Python.

Versión actual del paquete público: 0.3.1. La exportación normal no requiere Anki. Las API de los paquetes públicos difieren de las versiones compiladas desde el código fuente. Conserva el APKG original de la distribución anterior para las actualizaciones; las opciones de importación de Anki y los cambios locales más recientes pueden afectar al resultado.

- Rust: `cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1` (Rust 1.92+)
- Node / TypeScript: `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` (Node.js 22.13+)
- Python: `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+)

## Empieza aquí

- [Crea mazos de Anki con código](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/index.md): Elige un lenguaje, crea tu primer mazo de Anki y aprende a añadir imágenes, audio, plantillas y actualizaciones reproducibles.
- [Elige tu lenguaje de programación](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/languages/index.md): Instala el paquete publicado de Rust, Node.js o Python y exporta tu primer mazo de Anki.
- [Compatibilidad de Anki Forge y entornos verificados](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/compatibility/index.md): Consulta los paquetes públicos, los entornos probados y las condiciones de importación y reproducción en Anki.

## Primeros pasos

- [Genera un APKG de Anki con Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/quickstart/index.md): Instala el paquete de Rust, crea una tarjeta de vocabulario y exporta un archivo APKG persistente con un programa completo.
- [Genera un APKG de Anki con Node.js](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/node-quickstart/index.md): Instala el paquete publicado de Node.js y exporta tu primer mazo con un programa completo. Continúa con TypeScript, imágenes y actualizaciones.
- [Genera un APKG de Anki con Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/python-quickstart/index.md): Instala el wheel publicado de Python y crea tu primer archivo APKG de Anki con un programa completo y claves de nota estables.

## Referencias de las API

- [Resumen de la API pública](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/api/index.md): Encuentra las API de Rust, Python y Node para crear notas, añadir recursos multimedia, diagnosticar errores y revisar actualizaciones.
- [Referencia de la API de Rust](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/rust-api/index.md): Consulta los métodos de creación de contenido, las opciones de generación, los informes y los errores públicos de Rust.
- [API de Node y TypeScript](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/node-api/index.md): Métodos públicos de Node, operaciones asíncronas, opciones de generación, gestión de archivos de salida e informes.
- [API de Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/python-api/index.md): Project, recursos multimedia, opciones de generación, informes y gestión de la vida útil de los archivos temporales.

## Guías por tarea

- [CSV a Anki: crea tarjetas con Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/csv-to-anki/index.md): Convierte una hoja de vocabulario CSV UTF-8 en un APKG con un script completo de Python, ID de nota estables y comprobaciones de importación.

- [Crea tarjetas de Anki con ayuda de IA](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/ai-anki-cards/index.md): Prepara tarjetas a partir de tus apuntes con un asistente de IA, revisa las respuestas y exporta un APKG con Anki Forge mediante CSV o código.
- [Crea tarjetas Basic y Cloze de Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/cards/index.md): Genera desde código tarjetas Basic de Anki de pregunta y respuesta y tarjetas Cloze con huecos. Un ejemplo verificado de Rust crea dos notas y tres tarjetas.
- [Añade imágenes y audio a tus tarjetas Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/media/index.md): Añade imágenes y audio a las tarjetas Anki que generes con Rust, Python o Node.js. Importa archivos, combina contenido y gestiona nombres de exportación, tipos MIME y límites de importación.
- [Reutiliza plantillas de Anki, CSS y recursos multimedia](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/templates/index.md): Carga un tipo de nota de Anki reutilizable desde un paquete de plantillas, CSS y recursos multimedia, para tarjetas normales o Cloze, con Rust, Python o Node.js.
- [Genera tarjetas Anki con oclusión de imágenes](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/image-occlusion/index.md): Crea tarjetas de oclusión de imágenes de Anki desde código con Rust, Python o Node.js: proporciona la imagen y las máscaras rectangulares y elige uno de los dos modos de oclusión.

## Limitaciones

- [Identidades estables para actualizar mazos de Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/blog/stable-ids-and-deck-updates/index.md): Artículo histórico publicado el 2026-09-22. Cómo combinar ID estables y un paquete de referencia al actualizar un mazo de Anki generado.

```sh
python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1
```

En Windows, actívalo con `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. Usa CPython estándar 3.11 o posterior y un wheel que corresponda a tu plataforma; las comprobaciones de publicación registradas cubren CPython 3.11–3.14. Consulta los [entornos verificados](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/compatibility/).

## Exporta un mazo

Guarda lo siguiente como `main.py`:

```python
from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions

project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')
project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))
output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))
print(output.artifact.path)
```

```sh
python main.py
```

Abre el archivo persistente `spanish.apkg` en Anki. Contiene **hola → hello** en el mazo **Spanish**. Conserva el espacio de nombres `spanish` y la clave de nota `es:hola` cuando edites el contenido. No necesitas instalar Anki para exportarlo.

## Continúa

Si partes de una hoja de vocabulario, sigue [CSV a Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/csv-to-anki/). Para preparar borradores de tarjetas a partir de tus apuntes, empieza con la [creación de tarjetas con ayuda de IA](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/ai-anki-cards/).

Para completar una tarea con recursos multimedia y actualizaciones, sigue [JSON a Anki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/json-to-anki/#python).

-   [Imágenes y audio](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/media/) y [API multimedia de Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/python-api/#media-and-occlusion).
-   [Tipos de nota personalizados](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/custom-notetypes/) y [paquetes de plantillas](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/templates/).
-   [Oclusión de imágenes](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/image-occlusion/).
-   [Comparación y actualización](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/updates/).
-   [API de Python](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/python-api/) y [diagnósticos](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/python-diagnostics/).
-   [Migración desde genanki](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/genanki-migration/).

Para compilaciones nativas desde el repositorio, consulta la [guía de compilación desde el código fuente](https://morehardy.github.io/anki-forge/es/docs/development/).
